activity_summary: After the call you heard Anne's letter in your head and laughed without a sound. Quiney did not hear it. You did not tell him. Monday at six stands. You asked him for nothing.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Her letter was in his head. She was not on the call.

facets.activity: Laughed to himself after the call

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The laugh did not make a sound. He did not hear it.
